The temporary role was dropped 20 minutes later, strongly suggesting an attempt to conceal data exfiltration.   "rollback": "IRREVERSIBLE: Teleport generates a dynamic lock ID that cannot be statically predicted. To rollback, an administrator must retrieve the lock ID via 'tctl get locks' and run 'tctl rm lock/<lock-id>'.",

alert_summary.rule_name: Shadow role creation or default privilege alteration

evidence.statement: SELECT rolname FROM pg_roles WHERE rolcanlogin ORDER BY rolname
GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO svc_reporting
ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO svc_reporting
DROP OWNED BY svc_reporting; DROP ROLE svc_reporting

baseline_context.note: Role dba normally returns about 372 rows per simulated day across the 14-day baseline, almost all inside 08:00-17:00.
